BOTH MEMBERS NEUTRALIZE THE SAME WORD, INDEPENDENTLY [claim G52-38]. The chain reads 'I have divined' as I TESTED AND EXAMINED, a household audit rather than sorcery; Onkelos renders the identical word I HAVE TESTED. Full convergence with no citation either way, and the wage instruction is likewise read as calculate and quantify rather than guess. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

A DOCTRINE FROM A BREEDING SCENE USED TO DECIDE A HUMAN CASE [claim G52-34]. Having read the rods as maternal impression, the chain reports the doctrine operating in adjudication: a couple whose child did not resemble them, and the ruling given by pointing to the pale portraits in the house - it is from there. [folded shape: priced law]

Which animals fell to which party is argued between two authorities; Onkelos renders the split TEMPORALLY - the late-bearing to one, the early-bearing to the other - writing one side of that argument as the verse's plain sense.
